content:
name: Temporary WP-MVP-0004 closure

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - eosr/close-wp-mvp-0004
    paths:
      - .eos/wp-mvp-0004-close-trigger

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  close:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 35
    steps:
      - name: Check out exact closure branch
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Reconcile checklist, refresh evidence, and close
        shell: bash
        env:
          EXPECTED_MAIN_HEAD: 5f7fe570fd5bf2ac982e6f40ebb0a61f09d0dcad
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          git fetch origin main
          test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED_MAIN_HEAD"
          git merge-base --is-ancestor "$EXPECTED_MAIN_HEAD" HEAD

          rm .github/workflows/temporary-wp-mvp-0004-close.yml
          rm .eos/wp-mvp-0004-close-trigger
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          test -z "$(git diff --name-only "$EXPECTED_MAIN_HEAD" -- crates engineering .eos machine | grep -v '^$')"

          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          grep -q '^WP-MVP-0004.*IN_REVIEW' .eos/work-packets.tsv
          grep -q '^\*\*Decision:\*\* ACCEPTED$' engineering/reviews/WP-MVP-0004-REVIEW.md

          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          path = Path('engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0004.md')
          text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
          expected = [
              'US-011 section/heading/metadata structure and source ranges are extracted deterministically.',
              'US-012 governed identifiers/status metadata are extracted according to artifact contracts.',
              'US-013 links and identifier references are emitted as unresolved candidates with provenance.',
              'US-014 malformed/ambiguous governed constructs produce source-located diagnostics; partial recovery is not silently valid semantic state.',
              'code fences containing fake IDs/links are not treated as ordinary governed references.',
              'HTML/scripts/macros are never executed.',
              'repeat-run normalized output is equivalent/byte-stable where declared canonical.',
          ]
          for criterion in expected:
              old = f'- [ ] {criterion}'
              new = f'- [x] {criterion}'
              assert text.count(old) == 1, (criterion, text.count(old))
              text = text.replace(old, new)
          assert '- [ ] ' not in text
          assert text.count('- [x] ') == 7
          path.write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')
          PY

          cargo fmt --all -- --check
          cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
          cargo test --workspace --all-targets --all-features

          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0001 --profile wp
          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0002 --profile wp --execution EXEC-0004
          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0003 --profile wp --execution EXEC-0005
          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0004 --profile wp --execution EXEC-0009
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check

          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import csv
          wp = Path('engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0004.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
          assert '**Status:** IN_REVIEW' in wp
          assert wp.count('- [x] ') == 7
          assert '- [ ] ' not in wp
          rows = list(csv.DictReader(open('.eos/evidence.tsv'), delimiter='\t'))
          current = [r for r in rows if r['target'] == 'WP-MVP-0004' and r['status'] != 'SUPERSEDED']
          assert len(current) == 3, current
          assert all(r['execution'] == 'EXEC-0009' and r['status'] == 'VALIDATED' for r in current), current
          assert next(r for r in current if r['validator'] == 'eos-integrity')['result'] == 'PASSED'
          assert next(r for r in current if r['validator'] == 'repository')['result'] in {'PASSED', 'SKIPPED'}
          assert next(r for r in current if r['validator'] == 'execution-acceptance')['result'] == 'PASSED'
          PY

          ./scripts/eos gate explain WP_CLOSE WP-MVP-0004
          ./scripts/eos close WP-MVP-0004 --by "ChatGPT" --reason "all seven acceptance criteria independently verified; final EOSR accepted after F001 correction"

          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          ./scripts/eos state status
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          cargo fmt --all -- --check
          cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
          cargo test --workspace --all-targets --all-features

          grep -q '^\*\*Status:\*\* CLOSED$' engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0004.md
          grep -q '^WP-MVP-0004.*CLOSED' .eos/work-packets.tsv
          test "$(grep -c '^- \[x\]' engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0004.md)" -eq 7
          ! grep -q '^- \[ \]' engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0004.md
          grep -q '^\*\*Decision:\*\* ACCEPTED$' engineering/reviews/WP-MVP-0004-REVIEW.md

          mapfile -t changed < <({ git diff --name-only "$EXPECTED_MAIN_HEAD"; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard; } | sort -u)
          test "${#changed[@]}" -gt 0
          for f in "${changed[@]}"; do
            case "$f" in
              .eos/*|engineering/evidence/*|engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0004.md|machine/*) ;;
              *) echo "Out-of-scope WP-MVP-0004 closure path: $f" >&2; exit 1 ;;
            esac
          done

          git config user.name "ChatGPT"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add -A
          git commit -m "chore(eosr): close WP-MVP-0004"
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
          git push origin "HEAD:${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"
